PRE-DECLARED ANALYSIS: primary = the 7 new seeds only (independent of the 3 seeds that motivated the question); per level and pooled over the 3 levels (per-seed mean over levels), paired differences sparse-dense and sparse-linear with mean, sd, two-sided paired t 95% CI (df=6), and sign count.
